data.one_liner: Fast and high-quality TeX math equation rendering with pure Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Parses and renders TeX math equations directly in Flutter widgets with high fidelity to the KaTeX project. It provides both static rendering and a selectable math variant for copying equations.
use_when: You need to render mathematical formulas or TeX equations in your app.
You require select-and-copy support for rendered math text.
avoid_when: You need full UnicodeMath-style equation editing (not yet supported).
You require full MathML parsing and encoding.
strengths: High fidelity with the KaTeX project.
Supports web and mobile platforms with pure Dart and Flutter.
weaknesses: Editing support is currently experimental or limited.
